content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: (BIOC(MP-004 AWS CLI Invoked By www-data With Inline Access Key Env) AND XQL(MP-004 CloudTrail GetCallerIdentity From Unenrolled Source IP)) -> join on aws_access_key_id within 60s
rules.name: Hybrid Cloud Cred Pivot Stitch — XDR AWS CLI + CloudTrail Principal

rules.logic: (BIOC(MP-004 Cloud Multi Service Describe List Burst From Single Principal) AND BIOC(MP-004 GetBucketAcl And ListObjects On Sensitive Tagged Bucket)) -> join on aws_access_key_id within 300s
rules.name: Cloud Discovery To Collection Stitch — Multi Service Burst + Sensitive Bucket

rules.logic: (BIOC(MP-004 Recursive AWS Key Pattern Grep From Service Account) OR BIOC(MP-004 AWS CLI Invoked By www-data With Inline Access Key Env)) AND BIOC(MP-004 S3 CopyObject To Non Owned Destination Bucket) AND IOC(aws-s3-bucket: cortexsim-attacker-drop) -> join on principal within 1800s
rules.name: APT29 Full Kill Chain Stitch — Cred Dump To Cloud Exfil
